headline: SLB Eyes Rapid Data Center Growth Through $3.4 Billion Kelvion Deal
summary: SLB shares rise after agreeing to acquire Kelvion for $3.4 billion, expanding its data center infrastructure business and thermal management capabilities.

headline: Oil Jumps Near $90 On Iran Risk, California Utilities Crater: Stock Market Today
summary: Brent climbed after new U.S.-Iran strikes, pushing the 10-year yield to a 19-month high; Edison and PG&E collapsed on a wildfire bill.
